title: OperatorDecision
description: A decision of the operator: the words of the operator given in conversation, with the question they answer if there was one. Decisions are only added; a later one cancels an earlier one by its words.

number.description: Number of the decision within the task, from 1.

question.description: The question the operator answered; absent for words given without one.

options.description: Options of the answer offered with the question; absent if none were.

answer.description: The words of the operator as given; may have several lines.

node.description: Node of the pass the decision was recorded at.

allow_return.description: The node the decision allows one more return to from node, beyond the limit; absent if it allows none.

source.description: Who recorded the decision: operator, or agent from the words of the operator.

recorded.description: Time the decision was recorded in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.
